# NuNerve Notebook (nunerve.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for NuNerve, a liquid dropper supplement (amber bottle, Net Wt. 1 fl oz / 30 mL, labelled Advanced Nerve Support Formula) the seller says contains whole coffee fruit extract, PEA (palmitoylethanolamide), vitamins B12, B6 and B1, R-alpha lipoic acid, lion's mane mushroom and organic curcumin, marketed to support nerve health in adults. No amounts, serving size or Supplement Facts panel were supplied. Packs: 2 bottles $69 each ($138 plus shipping), 3 bottles $59 each ($177, free shipping, unnamed free bonuses), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free shipping, unnamed free bonuses); 60-day money-back guarantee (one banner says 180 days); one-time fee, no autoship.

IMPORTANT: NuNerve is a supplement, not a treatment for neuropathy, nerve damage or nerve pain, and no study of the liquid is shown. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Tingling and numbness need a diagnosis; sudden one-sided weakness, a drooping face or trouble speaking is an emergency. Alpha lipoic acid can lower blood sugar, high-dose vitamin B6 can itself harm nerves, curcumin may affect bleeding. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people should consult a physician.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
